'''Onsen-​riyō Shidōsha''' (温泉利用指導者) is a qualification awarded to individuals who complete an eight-day training course conducted by the {{ill|Japan Health Development Foundation|de|Japanische Stiftung für Gesundheitsentwicklung|ja|一般財団法人日本健康開発財団|zh|日本健康开发财团}}. Holders provide bathing instruction and general lifestyle guidance to those receiving {{ill|Balneotherapy|de|Thermalquellentherapie|ja|温泉療養|zh|温泉疗养|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to 温泉療法|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q2016490}} under the direction of a [[:en:Physician|physician]].

== Roles of Onsen-​riyō Shidōsha ==
* Implement bathing instruction and overall lifestyle guidance based on a hot spring therapy prescription prepared by a physician.  
* Manage facility safety and perform emergency life-saving procedures in the event of accidents.

== Program Overview ==
To obtain this qualification, candidates must complete an eight-day training course organized by the Japan Health Development Foundation. This is an advanced qualification above the {{ill|Onsen-​nyūyoku Shidōin|de|Onsen-Badeinstruktor|ja|温泉入浴指導員|zh|温泉入浴指导员}}. Prerequisites include being a {{ill|public health nurse|de|Öffentliche GesundheitskRankenschwester|ja|保健師|zh|公共卫生护士|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q67529900}}, {{ill|Registered dietitian|de|zugelassener Ernährungsberater|ja|管理栄養士|zh|注册营养师|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11603267}}, {{ill|health exercise instructor|de|Gesundheitssportleiter|ja|健康運動指導士|zh|健康运动指导师|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11387215}}, a graduate of a four-year {{ill|sports higher education institution|de|Sporthochschule|ja|体育大学|zh|体育大学|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q1499580}}, etc. The curriculum covers health science, balneology, {{ill|thermal physiology & therapy|de|Thermophysiologie und Therapie|ja|温熱生理・治療学|zh|热生理与治疗学|qid=DELETED_QID}}, first aid, and related subjects. Placement of an Onsen-​riyō Shidōsha is mandatory in Ministry-certified {{ill|hot spring utilization–type health promotion facilities|de|Thermalnutzungsprogramm-Gesundheitsförderungseinrichtungen|ja|温泉利用型健康増進施設|zh|温泉利用型健康促进设施|qid=DELETED_QID}}.
